items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Hank Jones and myself... Charlie and Buddy de Franco and Louis Bellson were on vacation from Tommy's band at the time. So this was a filler for them... Local boy returns home

ctx.x: Louis Bellson, Buddy de Franco, Charlie

Shavers, Hank Jones and myself. Hank never played a note. And Hank -- I mean, Charlie and Buddy de Franco and Louis Bellson were on vacation from Tommy's band at the time. So this was a filler for them, you know, playing his home town and everything, you know. Local boy returns home, you know.
How was it that Hank never played a note?
